ratification: Blocked: no owner decision record exists for any numeric budget or support-lane classification (see docs/reports/bwasm-d-004-support-matrix-budgets.md). Authorization to prepare design documents is not acceptance of proposed decisions.

size_budgets.note: compression codec must be brotli (server default for wasm); gzip-9 numbers are interim proxies until brotli tooling is wired into measurement

base_wasm_kernel.component: q-browser-kernel (verification/routing/validation/authz/problem mapping; no engine, no host)

optional_capability_bundle_each.component: loaded only when the artifact declares the capability

total_initial_transfer.component: base + glue + one app + declared capabilities

memory_repeated_lifecycle.criterion: 100 load/unload cycles; heap flat after warmup within run noise; numeric noise threshold UNSET pending measurement variance data

support_matrix.note: no browser-runtime CI lanes exist yet; no lane may be called tested until BWASM-Q-002 evidence exists

lanes.promotion_requires: BWASM-Q-002 real-browser CI lane passing conformance
independent device qualification; desktop results do not establish mobile support
device-lane evidence (Worker/WASM memory ceilings, storage partitioning)
n/a; startup must fail closed naming the missing feature

measurability_prototype.what: size-measurement procedure validation only; NOT performance evidence
commands: printf 'pub fn add(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32 { a.wrapping_add(b) }\n' > mini.rs
findings: std-linked cdylib dominates size: a one-function module is ~1.44 MiB raw / ~299 KiB gzip-9
wasm-opt absent on measurement host; without it, Rust wasm output cannot be dead-code-eliminated to realistic kernel size
brotli absent on measurement host; gzip-9 is an interim proxy (~10-15% larger than brotli typically)
procedure is reproducible (exact commands + hash recorded); latency/memory measurability still unvalidated because no kernel or browser harness exists

known_limitations_baseline: No browser runtime, kernel, or handler bundle exists yet; every budget is a proposal
No real-browser CI lane exists; no lane is tested
brotli and wasm-opt tooling gaps make current size numbers proxies
Cache Storage/IndexedDB can be evicted by the browser; offline and persistence are best-effort platform features, not guarantees

Worker ambient API exposure is unmitigated by design in trusted mode (ADR-0038 correction pending): the capability bridge mediates declared calls but cannot prevent direct browser-API calls from trusted handler code; untrusted-preview isolation relies on deployment posture (separate origin + sandboxed iframe), not the runtime
Engine parity is not claimed for the default Worker profile
quickjs-wasm remains behind an owner decision gate
